fields.summary_ko.0: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix fell 34% and 45%, respectively, over the past four months, yet average broker target prices rose 8.7% and 13.6%, widening the divergence between fundamentals and stock prices.
fields.summary_ko.1: Foreign investment banks absorbed profit-taking sales from convertible bond (EB) investors with high target prices, with some analysts shifting from PBR to PER valuations and doubling target prices.
fields.summary_ko.2: Repeated analyst optimism undermined investor discipline on stop-loss orders, raising concerns about breach of fiduciary duty and eroding trust in broker research.
